```{r load libraries, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(correlation)
library(psych)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(coin)
library(LambertW)
```

```{r}
data %>% 
 dplyr::select(user_id, Risk_Beta, Gain_Beta, age, sex, YearsOfEducation, Extraversion, Agreeableness,Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness, PerspectiveTaking, Fantasy, EmpathicConcern, PersonalDistress, POWER, SELF.DIRECTION,ACHIEVEMENT, HEDONISM, STIMULATION, UNIVERSALISM, BENEVOLENCE, TRADITION, CONFORMITY, SECURITY) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "tTZWd9tg") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "ZJ8tICU0") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "FIvIqXVg") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "4lsMLrPn") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "NEFYx2OX")-> data 
```


```{r}
options(scipen=999)

Neuroethics_Judgement <- read.csv("../data/Cleaned_Pilot/Cleaned_Pilot.09.csv", header=TRUE, comment.char="#", stringsAsFactors=TRUE)
  
Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
 dplyr::select(user_id, Risk_Beta, Gain_Beta, age, Income,HumanMind, Extraversion, Agreeableness,Conscientiousness, Neuroticism, Openness, PerspectiveTaking, Fantasy, EmpathicConcern, PersonalDistress, POWER, SELF.DIRECTION,ACHIEVEMENT, HEDONISM, STIMULATION, UNIVERSALISM, BENEVOLENCE, TRADITION, CONFORMITY, SECURITY) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(log.risk = log(Risk_Beta + 10)) %>% 
  mutate(log.gain = log(Gain_Beta + 10)) %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "tTZWd9tg") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "ZJ8tICU0") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "FIvIqXVg") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "4lsMLrPn") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "NEFYx2OX")-> data 

data$guaussian.risk <- Gaussianize(data$Risk_Beta)
data$guaussian.gain <- Gaussianize(data$Gain_Beta)
```


```{r}
data$POWER <- factor(data$POWER,
                     ordered = TRUE,
                     levels = c("0","1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8"))
```
